title: RPC envelope
description: The wire protocol between the daemon (server, loopback-bound) and the Unity package (client, reconnecting). Spec §6 'The connection model' — this is the M0 centerpiece. The daemon is authoritative for task state; Unity holds none.

hello.description: First message Unity sends on every connect/reconnect, including after a domain reload. If sessionToken/lastIdempotencyKey are present, this is a reconnect, not a fresh session.

sessionToken.description: Persisted in SessionState (survives domain reload) plus a workspace file (survives Editor restart). Null on a genuinely fresh connection.

lastIdempotencyKey.description: The idempotencyKey of the last in-flight transaction before the disconnect, if any. Lets the daemon decide re-issue vs. confirm vs. rollback.

reason.description: Why the client is (re)connecting — informs the daemon's reconciliation logic and is recorded for the task's editorRestartCount when reason=editor_restart.

compatible.description: false if unityVersion/packageSchemaVersion fail the daemon's supported-matrix check (spec §4 'pinned Unity 6.3 patch matrix'). Connection is refused, not silently degraded.

pendingReconciliation.description: Set when lastIdempotencyKey matched an in-flight transaction: tells Unity whether the daemon already has a result (confirm) or needs it retried (re_issue) or the checkpoint should be restored (rollback).

method.description: One of the tool-surface names from spec §9, e.g. scene.apply_transaction, editor.enter_play_mode, test.run.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for any mutating method (spec §7). Omitted for read-only inspection calls.

heartbeat.description: Sent by Unity on an interval while healthy. Absence for longer than the watchdog's per-operation timeout (spec §6 'Editor lifecycle recovery') triggers kill + relaunch.
